attributes.name: Hidden Beast
attributes.powers:
The Hidden Beast is immune to the Cold, Mental, and Poison traits.

Succeed at an Arcane or Divine 14 check or you may not play spells with the Attack trait against the Hidden Beast.

Before the encounter, each character at this location must succeed at a Combat 22 check or bury 1d4 random cards from his discard pile.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Hidden Beast, the first line should read "The Hidden Beast is immune to the Cold, Mental, and Poison traits.”
corrections.issue: The Hidden Beast is undead. Shouldn't it be immune to the Mental trait?
